cues.en: She came from Greece. She had a thirst for knowledge. She studied sculpture at Saint Martin's College. That's where I
cues.zh: 她来自希腊。她求知若渴。她在圣马丁学院学习雕塑。就在那里，我

cues.en: caught her eye.
cues.zh: 吸引了她的目光。

cues.en: She told me that her dad was loaded. I said, in that case, I'll have a rum and Coca Cola. She said, fine.
cues.zh: 她告诉我她老爸很有钱。我说，那我要一杯朗姆可乐。她说，行。

cues.en: And in thirty seconds time, she said,
cues.zh: 不到三十秒钟，她说，

cues.en: I wanna live like common people.
cues.zh: 我想过普通人的生活。

cues.en: I wanna do whatever common people do. I wanna sleep with common people. I wanna sleep with common people like you.
cues.zh: 我想做普通人做的一切。我想和普通人同床共枕。我想和像你一样的普通人同床共枕。

cues.en: Well, what else could I do? I said, I'll see what I can do.
cues.zh: 好吧，我还能怎样？我说，我看看我能做点什么。

cues.en: I took her to a supermarket.
cues.zh: 我带她去了超市。

cues.en: I don't know why, but I had to start it somewhere.
cues.zh: 我不知道为什么，但我总得找个地方开始。

cues.en: So it started there.
cues.zh: 于是故事就在那儿开始了。

cues.en: I said, pretend you've got no money.
cues.zh: 我说，假装你身无分文。

cues.en: She just laughed and said, oh, you're so funny.
cues.zh: 她只是笑着说，噢，你真逗。

cues.en: I said, yeah.
cues.zh: 我说，是啊。

cues.en: Well, I can't see anyone else smiling in here. Are you sure?
cues.zh: 你看这地方还有谁在笑吗？你确定吗？

cues.en: You wanna live like common people? You wanna see whatever common people see? You wanna sleep with common people? You wanna sleep with common people like me, but she
cues.zh: 你想过普通人的生活？你想看普通人看到的一切？你想和普通人同床共枕？你想和像我一样的普通人同床共枕，但她

cues.en: didn't understand.
cues.zh: 根本不懂。

cues.en: She's just smart and have my hands.
cues.zh: 她只是聪明而且有我这样的双手。

cues.en: Rent a plaza,
cues.zh: 租下广场，

cues.en: watching roaches climb the wall.
cues.zh: 看着蟑螂顺着墙壁往上爬。

cues.en: If you called your dad, he could stop it on him. You'll never live like common people.
cues.zh: 如果你给你爸打电话，他一句话就能摆平。你永远过不上普通人的生活。

cues.en: You'll never do whatever
cues.zh: 你永远不会做

cues.en: common people do. You'll never fail like common people. You'll never watch your life
cues.zh: 普通人做的事。你永远不会像普通人那样失败。你永远不会眼睁睁看着生命

cues.en: slide out of you and dance and brink and screw because there's nothing else to do.
cues.zh: 从你体内流逝，只能跳舞、喝酒、胡闹，因为无事可做。

cues.en: Stupid things that you do because you think that poor
cues.zh: 你做那些蠢事，只是因为你觉得贫穷

cues.en: is cool.
cues.zh: 很酷。

cues.en: Like the dog lying in a corner,
cues.zh: 就像趴在角落里的那只狗，

cues.en: they'll bite you and never warn you. Look out.
cues.zh: 它们咬你之前绝不会警告你。小心点。

cues.en: They'll tear your insides out
cues.zh: 它们会把你内脏都掏空，

cues.en: because everybody hates a tourist. Because everybody hates a tourist,
cues.zh: 因为人人都讨厌游客。因为人人都讨厌游客，

cues.en: especially one who
cues.zh: 尤其是那种
